entry_item.definition: v.t. To mark, check off, make a mark; to note down; to give a signal.

example.definition: To take notice; to take notes, note down.
To enter in a register or book.

entry_item.definition: faire une marque, mettre un signal, marquer, remarquer, donner à qn. une marque de distinction, distinguer.
v.t. To earmark. To mark. To label
